year_launched.note: First informatics nursing certification offered in 1995 (scope of practice statement 1994). Credential designation updated from RN-BC to NI-BC in 2023.

accreditation.value: Accredited by the Accreditation Board for Specialty Nursing Certification (ABSNC) and the National Commission for Certifying Agencies (NCCA).

eligibility.value: Hold a current, active RN license in a U.S. state/territory (or legally recognized equivalent abroad); hold a bachelor's or higher degree in nursing; have practiced the equivalent of 2 years full-time as an RN; have completed 30 hours of continuing education in informatics nursing within the last 3 years; AND meet one of three practice-hour options: (1) 2,000 hours in informatics nursing within the last 3 years; OR (2) 1,000 hours in informatics nursing in the last 3 years plus 12 semester hours of graduate-level informatics nursing coursework; OR (3) completion of a graduate program in informatics nursing with at least 200 hours of faculty-supervised informatics practicum.

exam_format.value: Computer-based test delivered year-round through Prometric test centers; 3 hours to answer 150 questions (125 scored + 25 unscored pretest). 120-day testing window after approval.

question_count_official.note: ANCC official Test Content Outline (effective May 3, 2023) and the certification page both state 150 questions (125 scored + 25 pretest). The exam was reduced from 175 to 150 in the May 2023 update. NOTE: project canonical certs.js lists 175 (pre-2023 figure). Per skill conflict rule certs.js wins as canonical, but the verified current value is 150. See discrepancies.

fee_admin_nonrefundable.value: $140 non-refundable administrative fee included in prices above

pass_rate.note: First-time test takers, 2025: 352 tested, 229 passed = 65% pass rate.

renewal.value: Certification is valid for 5 years. Renew by meeting professional development / continuing education requirements between certification start and end dates. Renewal applications accepted up to 1 year before expiration.

renewal_ce_hours.note: 75 CE contact hours commonly cited for ANCC specialty renewal; ANCC requires meeting renewal category requirements in the ANCC Certification Renewal Requirements handbook. Exact category mix not verified to a single primary line item.

common_confusions.value: RN-BC (the former designation for this same credential, retired in 2023, still seen on older nurses' badges); CAHIMS and CPHIMS (HIMSS-issued health-IT certifications open to non-nurses); ANA membership vs. ANIA (American Nursing Informatics Association) membership, which carry different exam discounts.

salary_context.value: BLS does not track nursing informaticists as a discrete occupation. Closest BLS proxies (May 2024): medical and health services managers median ~$117,960; registered nurses median ~$93,600. Industry/HIMSS surveys report a majority of nurse informaticists earning base salaries above $100,000.

discrepancies.resolution: Per skill conflict rule, certs.js is canonical and trusted for structural fields. However, the verified current ANCC value (effective May 3, 2023) is 150 questions (125 scored + 25 pretest); 175 was the pre-2023 figure. Recommend the user update certs.js. The page data file uses 150 (verified ANCC current value).
